query:
SELECT s.id, s.name,
               (
                   SELECT d.host FROM domains d
                   WHERE d.service_id = s.id AND NOT d.is_preview
                   ORDER BY d.created_at
                   LIMIT 1
               ) AS "host?"
        FROM services s
        JOIN access_policies p ON p.service_id = s.id AND p.enabled
        ORDER BY s.name
